method: Direct visual inspection of all three PNGs using view_image; comparison to definitions and saved endpoint/jet receipts
observations: Four signed panels preserve Pm/Pr opposing signs; Ptot is the signed tensor sum and S has the radiation sign after initial cancellation release.
Norm panels are nonnegative; cancellation has its full denominator and lies near0.39 at endpoint. Opposite-sign pairs nearly overlap but are separate arrays; no exact antisymmetry is asserted.
Filled new and hollow existing endpoint markers use exact sampled inputs; no interpolation grid.
Local jet plot distinguishes new4 from existing4 in separate rows with shared column scales and excludes eta=0 from S/eta^2.
Plots use full Frobenius signed coordinates; norms are absolute values. Figures show stored numerical samples, not certified continuous curves.
